How fast will I see results?

Variable. GMBRank.ai tracks progress weekly, but Google Maps ranking timing depends on your starting point, location, and competition.

Do I need technical skills?

No. GMBRank.ai presents Google Business Profile recommendations in plain English. Review and approve the changes you want.

Will it work for my industry?

Yes. GMBRank.ai supports US local businesses in home services, healthcare, legal services, and restaurants. Your Google Business Profile informs recommendations.

Do I need a Google Business Profile already?

Yes. GMBRank.ai needs your verified Google Business Profile. Create and verify your listing with Google before connecting it.

What happens to my profile — do you change things without asking?

No. GMBRank.ai presents proposed Google Business Profile changes first. You decide what gets approved.

What does the AI check?

Profiles. GMBRank.ai reviews Google Business Profile completeness, categories, keywords, reviews, photos, posts, and local competitors.

Can I track more than one search term?

Yes. GMBRank.ai supports unlimited keyword tracking across neighborhoods. Compare your Google Maps visibility for different service searches.

Can you guarantee I will rank #1?

No. GMBRank.ai cannot guarantee a #1 Google Maps position. Rankings depend on competition, location, and Google.

How is this different from hiring an SEO agency?

Software. GMBRank.ai includes weekly recommendations, neighborhood tracking, review tools, and reporting for $99/month. You approve profile changes.

How do I get started?

Start. Open the GMBRank.ai signup page, create your account, and connect your verified Google Business Profile. Your trial lasts 14 days.

See where your business ranks on Google Maps, run a free mini geo-grid and audit any Google Business Profile — right inside Google Maps. Free to install, no account needed for basic checks.

How fast will I see results?

Variable. GMBRank.ai tracks progress weekly, but Google Maps ranking timing depends on your starting point, location, and competition.

Do I need technical skills?

No. GMBRank.ai presents Google Business Profile recommendations in plain English. Review and approve the changes you want.

Will it work for my industry?

是的。 GMBRank.ai supports US local businesses in home services, healthcare, legal services, and restaurants. Your Google Business Profile informs recommendations.

Do I need a Google Business Profile already?

是的。 GMBRank.ai needs your verified Google Business Profile. Create and verify your listing with Google before connecting it.

What happens to my profile — do you change things without asking?

No. GMBRank.ai presents proposed Google Business Profile changes first. You decide what gets approved.

What does the AI check?

Profiles. GMBRank.ai reviews Google Business Profile completeness, categories, keywords, reviews, photos, posts, and local competitors.

Can I track more than one search term?

是的。 GMBRank.ai supports unlimited keyword tracking across neighborhoods. Compare your Google Maps visibility for different service searches.

Can you guarantee I will rank #1?

No. GMBRank.ai cannot guarantee a #1 Google Maps position. Rankings depend on competition, location, and Google.

How is this different from hiring an SEO agency?

软件。 GMBRank.ai includes weekly recommendations, neighborhood tracking, review tools, and reporting for $99/month. You approve profile changes.

How do I get started?

开始。 Open the GMBRank.ai signup page, create your account, and connect your verified Google Business Profile. Your trial lasts 14 days.
